description: Somehow, life after UW led me here, to a small bakery in Bellevue.  Over the years, people have discovered HoneyMe through our face cakes, custom cakes, and DIY workshops. We’ve tried so many ideas, hoping one might become the thing that truly defines us. Lately, I’ve been wondering… could it be our shio pan? It took us three months to get the recipe right: a buttery Japanese salt bread with a golden, crispy bottom. Some customers already come back for it again and again, but most people still don’t know we make it. So for the next 30 days, I’m giving this little bread a real try and seeing how far one little bread and our small bakery can go. This is Day 1. 🥐 Have you tried our shio pan yet? Tell me which flavor we should make next. 📍HoneyMe Bakery & Cafe, Bellevue #bellevue #seattlefoodie #seattle #seattletiktok #shiopan
